verdicts.reason: A is broken: the chevrons are blown up into huge black shapes that dominate the canvas, 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN' has fallen far below 'London' at a tiny size, so the headline reads out of order, and the translucent panel is left floating loose behind no text. B keeps the original reading order and the scale of each element, but it drops the panel, so the dark text sits straight on a busy, blurry, low-contrast photo. The copy is also bunched as a small cluster left of centre, and the '<<<' chevrons drift off to the side.
